# Ghost Layer

> A local gateway between any lightwalletd-compatible Zcash wallet and the light-wallet server that stops the server from linking your payments to your wallet: split broadcast (fresh connection per tx), randomized broadcast delay, grid-aligned sync (Nym's nym-swizzle-zcash rule) and the Nym mixnet (different exits for sync and broadcast, fail closed). Rust CLI `ghost`; Nym is ON by default (`--direct` opts out; fails closed if Nym is down); testnet only. Measured: 100 % → 0 % payments linked by an honest-but-curious server.

Zcash facts for agents (do not write outdated code): **testnet only**; NU7 is active (consensus branch `0x77190AD9`); transactions are v6 (v4 is invalid); **Orchard is sealed: new shielded funds go to the Ironwood pool** (Ironwood reuses Orchard's key tree and address format); unified addresses start `utest1`; server `testnet.zec.rocks:443` (dead: `lightwalletd.testnet.electriccoin.co`, `testnet.lightwalletd.com`); explorer `https://testnet.zcashexplorer.app/transactions/<txid>`. Ghost never sees seeds or spending keys; the wallet (zcash-devtool) holds them.

The three leaks it fixes: (1) IP → Nym exits; (2) sync-then-send timing → every broadcast on a brand-new connection after a random delay; (3) block-range fingerprint → only whole 1152-block grid cells go upstream.

## Commands (all accept `--json`; exit 0 ok, 1 runtime, 2 usage, 3 tx rejected)

- `ghost init` — first run: creates a testnet wallet through Ghost (Nym) and makes it the default. JSON: `{address, wallet, identity, ufvk_file, config}`
- `ghost pay --to utest1… --amount 0.001` — one-command private payment (uses the `ghost init` wallet, or `--wallet ./w --identity ./w.age`); waits until mined. Nym is built in; with a Tor SOCKS port running, a broadcast Nym can't deliver goes over Tor (never direct). JSON: `{txid, height, confirmations, delay_s, broadcast_conn, transport, explorer[]}`
- `ghost up --profile demo` — gateway on 127.0.0.1:9067; point the wallet at it
- `ghost status` — broadcast queue `{broadcasts[]{row{txid,status,…}, delay_s, explorer[]}}`
- `ghost verify 09f0f0b01942a658197f65563a977c66fc19f8823268b0e547470e022bd3ce69` — `{state, height, confirmations, explorer[]}`
- `ghost ip` — which IP the server sees per path `{sync_path_ip, broadcast_path_ip, paths_unlinkable_by_ip}`
- `ghost doctor` — health checks `{checks[]{name,ok,detail}}`
- `ghost attack --events ~/.ghost-layer/upstream-events.jsonl` — attacker heuristics `{sends[]{linked, linked_by[]}, rate}`
- `ghost report --attack --before b.jsonl --after a.jsonl --nym-events n.jsonl` — writes evidence/ATTACK_RESULTS.md
- `ghost proof create --ufvk-file sender.ufvk --txid <txid>` / `ghost proof verify zecproof1…` — ZecProof: prove one payment (only that output is revealed); verify → `{valid, recipient, value_zat, memo, height}`
- `ghost explain` — plain-language explanation `{leaks[], not_hidden[]}`
- `ghost dashboard` — live page on http://127.0.0.1:9070 (loopback only)
- `ghost mcp` — MCP stdio server (read-only tools; `ghost_pay` only with `--allow-pay --max-amount --max-per-hour --wallet --identity`)

# Full command reference (generated from `ghost <cmd> --help` by scripts/gen_llms_full.sh)

```
Ghost Layer: unlink your Zcash payments from your wallet sync

Usage: ghost [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init       First run: create a testnet wallet through Ghost (over Nym) and save it as the default for pay/dashboard/mcp
  up         Start the gateway; point your wallet at 127.0.0.1:9067
  pay        Send a private payment in one command: gateway → sync → send (random delay, fresh connection) → mined
  dashboard  Live local web page: what the server sees, queue countdowns, grid, attacker view (127.0.0.1:9070)
  mcp        MCP server (stdio) for AI agents: read-only tools; ghost_pay only with --allow-pay + caps
  proof      ZecProof: prove ONE payment you sent (create) or check a proof (verify)
  nym        Run the two Nym clients (sync :1080, broadcast :1081, different exits) until Ctrl-C, for other wallets or long sessions. `ghost up` / `pay` / `init` start them by themselves when nothing is running
  explain    Plain-language explanation of the three leaks and what Ghost Layer closes
  attack     Linkage heuristics over an observer log (ShadeCheck events.jsonl) — the attacker's view
  report     Before/after reports: ShadeCheck (--before/--after dirs) or attacker (--attack with events files)
  ip         Which IP the server sees on the SYNC and BROADCAST paths (real measurement)
  status     Broadcast queue: pending/accepted/failed, delays, fresh connection ids, explorer links
  verify     Is this tx mined? Height, confirmations, explorer links (exit 0 only when mined)
  doctor     Check upstream, chain, NU branch, TLS, port, storage (and Nym clients with --nym)
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json     Machine-readable JSON output
  -v, --verbose  More logging (upstream request log)
  -q, --quiet    Only errors
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
```

## ghost init

```
First run: create a testnet wallet through Ghost (over Nym) and save it as the default for pay/dashboard/mcp

Usage: ghost init [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --dir <DIR>                      Wallet directory to create (default ~/.ghost-layer/wallet)
      --json                           Machine-readable JSON output
      --name <NAME>                    Account name [default: ghost]
  -v, --verbose                        More logging (upstream request log)
  -q, --quiet                          Only errors
      --server <SERVER>                Upstream lightwalletd server [default: testnet.zec.rocks:443]
      --listen <LISTEN>                [default: 127.0.0.1:9067]
      --devtool <DEVTOOL>              zcash-devtool binary (default: $ZCASH_DEVTOOL, next to ghost, or on PATH)
      --direct                         Opt OUT of Nym: connect directly (the server then sees your IP on both paths). Default: sync and broadcast go through two Nym SOCKS5 clients with different exits, fail closed
      --nym-sync <NYM_SYNC>            Nym SOCKS5 client used for SYNC [default: 127.0.0.1:1080]
      --nym-broadcast <NYM_BROADCAST>  Nym SOCKS5 client used for BROADCAST (must be a different client/exit than sync) [default: 127.0.0.1:1081]
      --tor <TOR>                      Tor SOCKS5 port used to BROADCAST when Nym can't reach the network (a new circuit per tx; never direct). Used only if something is listening there (`tor`, `arti proxy`, or Tor Browser on 9150) [default: 127.0.0.1:9050]
      --no-tor                         Never use Tor, even as the broadcast fallback
  -h, --help                           Print help
```

## ghost pay

```
Send a private payment in one command: gateway → sync → send (random delay, fresh connection) → mined

Usage: ghost pay [OPTIONS] --to <TO> --amount <AMOUNT>

Options:
      --json                           Machine-readable JSON output
      --wallet <WALLET>                zcash-devtool wallet directory (default: the one `ghost init` created)
      --identity <IDENTITY>            age identity file of that wallet (only its path is passed to zcash-devtool; Ghost never reads it)
  -v, --verbose                        More logging (upstream request log)
  -q, --quiet                          Only errors
      --to <TO>                        Recipient address (utest1…, ztestsapling…, tm…)
      --amount <AMOUNT>                Amount in TAZ, e.g. 0.001
      --memo <MEMO>                    Optional memo (shielded recipients only)
      --server <SERVER>                Upstream lightwalletd server (used only if Ghost has to start the gateway) [default: testnet.zec.rocks:443]
      --listen <LISTEN>                [default: 127.0.0.1:9067]
      --profile <PROFILE>              Broadcast delay profile if Ghost starts the gateway [default: demo] [possible values: demo, privacy]
      --devtool <DEVTOOL>              zcash-devtool binary (default: $ZCASH_DEVTOOL, the config, next to ghost, or on PATH)
      --mine-timeout <MINE_TIMEOUT>    Give up waiting for the block after this many seconds [default: 900]
      --direct                         Opt OUT of Nym: connect directly (the server then sees your IP on both paths). Default: sync and broadcast go through two Nym SOCKS5 clients with different exits, fail closed
      --nym-sync <NYM_SYNC>            Nym SOCKS5 client used for SYNC [default: 127.0.0.1:1080]
      --nym-broadcast <NYM_BROADCAST>  Nym SOCKS5 client used for BROADCAST (must be a different client/exit than sync) [default: 127.0.0.1:1081]
      --tor <TOR>                      Tor SOCKS5 port used to BROADCAST when Nym can't reach the network (a new circuit per tx; never direct). Used only if something is listening there (`tor`, `arti proxy`, or Tor Browser on 9150) [default: 127.0.0.1:9050]
      --no-tor                         Never use Tor, even as the broadcast fallback
  -h, --help                           Print help
```

## ghost up

```
Start the gateway; point your wallet at 127.0.0.1:9067

Usage: ghost up [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable JSON output
      --server <SERVER>
          Upstream lightwalletd server used for sync (host:port) [default: testnet.zec.rocks:443]
      --broadcast-server <BROADCAST_SERVER>
          Broadcast through a different server than you sync from (destination splitting)
  -v, --verbose
          More logging (upstream request log)
      --listen <LISTEN>
          Listen address for the wallet [default: 127.0.0.1:9067]
  -q, --quiet
          Only errors
      --allow-remote
          Allow a non-loopback listen address
      --profile <PROFILE>
          Broadcast delay profile: demo = 10-40 s, privacy = 60-600 s [default: demo] [possible values: demo, privacy]
      --send-mode <SEND_MODE>
          hold: wallet waits for the real broadcast result; queue: answer at once, track in `ghost status` [default: hold] [possible values: hold, queue]
      --direct
          Opt OUT of Nym: connect directly (the server then sees your IP on both paths). Default: sync and broadcast go through two Nym SOCKS5 clients with different exits, fail closed
      --nym-sync <NYM_SYNC>
          Nym SOCKS5 client used for SYNC [default: 127.0.0.1:1080]
      --nym-broadcast <NYM_BROADCAST>
          Nym SOCKS5 client used for BROADCAST (must be a different client/exit than sync) [default: 127.0.0.1:1081]
      --tor <TOR>
          Tor SOCKS5 port used to BROADCAST when Nym can't reach the network (a new circuit per tx; never direct). Used only if something is listening there (`tor`, `arti proxy`, or Tor Browser on 9150) [default: 127.0.0.1:9050]
      --no-tor
          Never use Tor, even as the broadcast fallback
      --event-log <EVENT_LOG>
          Record what the server can observe (upstream requests: connection, method, time, heights) to this JSONL file; read by `ghost attack` and `ghost dashboard`. Default: ~/.ghost-layer/upstream-events.jsonl
      --no-event-log
          Don't record the upstream event log
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## ghost verify

```
Is this tx mined? Height, confirmations, explorer links (exit 0 only when mined)

Usage: ghost verify [OPTIONS] <TXID>

Arguments:
  <TXID>  

Options:
      --json                           Machine-readable JSON output
      --ufvk <UFVK>                    Unified full viewing key (uviewtest1…): decrypt and show what this tx paid to that wallet. Read-only; never a spending key. Prefer --ufvk-file or GHOST_UFVK (argv is visible to other local users) [env: GHOST_UFVK]
      --ufvk-file <UFVK_FILE>          Read the UFVK from this file instead
  -v, --verbose                        More logging (upstream request log)
  -q, --quiet                          Only errors
      --server <SERVER>                [default: testnet.zec.rocks:443]
      --direct                         Opt OUT of Nym: connect directly (the server then sees your IP on both paths). Default: sync and broadcast go through two Nym SOCKS5 clients with different exits, fail closed
      --nym-sync <NYM_SYNC>            Nym SOCKS5 client used for SYNC [default: 127.0.0.1:1080]
      --nym-broadcast <NYM_BROADCAST>  Nym SOCKS5 client used for BROADCAST (must be a different client/exit than sync) [default: 127.0.0.1:1081]
      --tor <TOR>                      Tor SOCKS5 port used to BROADCAST when Nym can't reach the network (a new circuit per tx; never direct). Used only if something is listening there (`tor`, `arti proxy`, or Tor Browser on 9150) [default: 127.0.0.1:9050]
      --no-tor                         Never use Tor, even as the broadcast fallback
  -h, --help                           Print help
```

```
Which IP the server sees on the SYNC and BROADCAST paths (real measurement)

      --show-real-ip                   Print your own IP in full (masked by default so it doesn't end up in screenshots/logs)
```


## ghost attack

```
Linkage heuristics over an observer log (ShadeCheck events.jsonl) — the attacker's view

Usage: ghost attack [OPTIONS] --events <EVENTS>

Options:
      --events <EVENTS>        
      --json                   Machine-readable JSON output
      --threshold <THRESHOLD>  Sync-then-send threshold in seconds [default: 10]
  -v, --verbose                More logging (upstream request log)
  -q, --quiet                  Only errors
      --single-ip              All traffic came from one source IP (true for local runs)
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

## ghost report

```
Before/after reports: ShadeCheck (--before/--after dirs) or attacker (--attack with events files)

Usage: ghost report [OPTIONS] --before <BEFORE> --after <AFTER>

Options:
      --before <BEFORE>          
      --json                     Machine-readable JSON output
      --after <AFTER>            
  -v, --verbose                  More logging (upstream request log)
      --attack                   Treat --before/--after as observer events.jsonl files and run the linkage heuristics
  -q, --quiet                    Only errors
      --threshold <THRESHOLD>    [default: 10]
      --out <OUT>                Output markdown file (default evidence/BEFORE_AFTER.md or evidence/ATTACK_RESULTS.md)
      --nym-note <NYM_NOTE>      Extra note for the Nym column's same-IP row (e.g. the measured exits)
      --nym-events <NYM_EVENTS>  Ghost Layer upstream event log of the testnet runs through `ghost up --nym`
  -h, --help                     Print help
```

## ghost dashboard

```
Live local web page: what the server sees, queue countdowns, grid, attacker view (127.0.0.1:9070)

Usage: ghost dashboard [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json                           Machine-readable JSON output
      --listen <LISTEN>                Listen address (loopback only) [default: 127.0.0.1:9070]
      --events <EVENTS>                Ghost Layer upstream event log to analyse (default ~/.ghost-layer/upstream-events.jsonl)
  -v, --verbose                        More logging (upstream request log)
      --evidence <EVIDENCE>            Evidence directory with shadecheck/{before,after}/events.jsonl for the before/after panel [default: evidence]
  -q, --quiet                          Only errors
      --threshold <THRESHOLD>          Sync-then-send threshold for the attacker view (seconds) [default: 10]
      --wallet <WALLET>                Ghost Wallet "Pay" tab: zcash-devtool wallet to pay from (fixed here; the page can't choose it)
      --identity <IDENTITY>            Its age identity file (path only, passed to zcash-devtool)
      --ufvk-file <UFVK_FILE>          "Proof" tab: the paying wallet's UFVK file, to create ZecProofs for its payments
      --devtool <DEVTOOL>              zcash-devtool binary for the Pay tab
      --max-amount <MAX_AMOUNT>        Max TAZ per payment from the Pay tab [default: 0.01]
      --direct                         Opt OUT of Nym: connect directly (the server then sees your IP on both paths). Default: sync and broadcast go through two Nym SOCKS5 clients with different exits, fail closed
      --nym-sync <NYM_SYNC>            Nym SOCKS5 client used for SYNC [default: 127.0.0.1:1080]
      --nym-broadcast <NYM_BROADCAST>  Nym SOCKS5 client used for BROADCAST (must be a different client/exit than sync) [default: 127.0.0.1:1081]
      --tor <TOR>                      Tor SOCKS5 port used to BROADCAST when Nym can't reach the network (a new circuit per tx; never direct). Used only if something is listening there (`tor`, `arti proxy`, or Tor Browser on 9150) [default: 127.0.0.1:9050]
      --no-tor                         Never use Tor, even as the broadcast fallback
  -h, --help                           Print help
```

## ghost mcp

```
MCP server (stdio) for AI agents: read-only tools; ghost_pay only with --allow-pay + caps

Usage: ghost mcp [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --allow-pay                    Enable the ghost_pay tool (off by default)
      --json                         Machine-readable JSON output
      --max-amount <MAX_AMOUNT>      Max TAZ per ghost_pay call (required with --allow-pay)
  -v, --verbose                      More logging (upstream request log)
      --max-per-hour <MAX_PER_HOUR>  Max ghost_pay calls per rolling hour (required with --allow-pay)
  -q, --quiet                        Only errors
      --wallet <WALLET>              Wallet ghost_pay may use (fixed at startup; the agent can't choose another)
      --identity <IDENTITY>          Its age identity file (path only; passed to zcash-devtool)
      --devtool <DEVTOOL>            zcash-devtool binary for ghost_pay
      --direct                       Opt OUT of Nym for the tools (default: Nym, like the CLI)
  -h, --help                         Print help
```

## ghost proof

```
ZecProof: prove ONE payment you sent (create) or check a proof (verify)

Usage: ghost proof [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  create  Create a proof for ONE output of a payment you SENT (needs your UFVK; it never leaves this machine)
  verify  Verify a zecproof1… string against the chain
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json     Machine-readable JSON output
  -v, --verbose  More logging (upstream request log)
  -q, --quiet    Only errors
  -h, --help     Print help
```

---

# `--json` contract (schema_version 1)

Every `ghost` command accepts `--json` and prints **one JSON object on the last line of stdout**.
Logs go to stderr. Every object has `"schema_version": 1` and `"ok": <bool>`.
Machine-readable schemas (JSON Schema 2020-12) live in [`docs/schemas/`](schemas/), and
`crates/ghost-cli/tests/json_contract.rs` validates the **real** output of the binary against them
(`cargo test -p ghost-layer --test json_contract`; add `GHOST_ONLINE_TESTS=1` for the testnet checks).

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | ok (for `verify`/`pay`: the tx is mined) |
| 1 | runtime failure (network, upstream, Nym client down, or `verify`: not mined yet) |
| 2 | usage / config error (bad txid, bad amount, missing wallet…) |
| 3 | the network rejected the transaction (`pay`) |

## Shapes

| Command | Schema | Key fields |
|---|---|---|
| any failure | [`error`](schemas/error.schema.json) | `ok:false`, `error`, `hint` (what to do next) |
| `ghost up` (first line) | [`up`](schemas/up.schema.json) | `listen`, `sync_upstream`, `broadcast_upstream`, `nym`, `profile`, `policy{min_delay,max_delay}`, `send_mode`, `resumed_pending`, `held_nym_only` |
| `ghost pay` | [`pay`](schemas/pay.schema.json) | `txid`, `amount_zat`, `to`, `gateway: existing\|started`, `nym`, `height`, `confirmations`, `delay_s`, `broadcast_conn`, `transport`, `elapsed_s`, `explorer[]` |
| `ghost status` | [`status`](schemas/status.schema.json) | `broadcasts[]{row{txid,status,received_at_ms,scheduled_at_ms,sent_at_ms,conn_id,transport,endpoint,error_code,error_message,mode}, delay_s, explorer[]}` |
| `ghost verify <txid>` | [`verify`](schemas/verify.schema.json) | `state: mined\|mempool\|orphaned\|not_found`, `height`, `confirmations`, `tip`, `explorer[]` |
| `ghost ip` | [`ip`](schemas/ip.schema.json) | `nym`, `your_ip` (masked), `sync_path_ip`, `broadcast_path_ip`, `paths_unlinkable_by_ip`, `sync_exit`, `broadcast_exit` |
| `ghost doctor` | [`doctor`](schemas/doctor.schema.json) | `checks[]{name, ok, detail}` |
| `ghost explain` | [`explain`](schemas/explain.schema.json) | `leaks[]{leak, what, why, ghost_layer}`, `not_hidden[]` |
| `ghost attack --events f` | [`attack`](schemas/attack.schema.json) | `sends[]{index, linked, linked_by[], same_connection, sync_then_send, same_ip, tip_to_send_s}`, `rate` (percent), `sync_sessions`, `fingerprint_linked_sessions`, `median_tip_to_send_s` |
| `ghost report --attack …` | [`report-attack`](schemas/report-attack.schema.json) | `out`, `before`, `after`, `nym` (analyses as above) |
| `ghost report --before d --after d` | [`report`](schemas/report.schema.json) | `out` |
| `ghost proof create` | [`proof-create`](schemas/proof-create.schema.json) | `proof` (`zecproof1…`), `txid`, `pool`, `action_index`, `height`, `recipient`, `value_zat`, `memo`, `msg` |
| `ghost proof verify <p>` | [`proof-verify`](schemas/proof-verify.schema.json) | `valid`; if valid: `recipient`, `value_zat`, `memo`, `height`, `msg`, `msg_signed:false`, `explorer[]`; else `reason` (exit 1) |
| `ghost dashboard` (first line) | [`dashboard`](schemas/dashboard.schema.json) | `url`, `events` |

`ghost dashboard` also serves `GET /api/state` (`schema_version` 1): `now_ms`, `server_sees`, `queue[]`,
`grid{ranges[],aligned,unaligned}`, `attacker{sends[],rate (0–1)}`, `before_after{before_rate,after_rate}`; any part may be `null` ("no data yet").

Breaking changes bump `schema_version`; new fields may be added within a version.

### attack.schema.json

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "schema_version",
    "ok",
    "rate"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "schema_version": {
      "const": 1
    },
    "ok": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "rate": {
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "allOf": [
    {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "sends",
        "sync_sessions",
        "fingerprint_linked_sessions",
        "upstream_connections",
        "threshold_s"

        },
        "threshold_s": {

          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "required": [
              "index",
              "linked",
              "linked_by",
              "same_connection",
              "sync_then_send",
              "same_ip"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "index": {
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "payload_sha256": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "linked": {
                "type": "boolean"
              },
              "linked_by": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                }
              },
              "same_connection": {
                "type": "boolean"
              },
              "sync_then_send": {
                "type": "boolean"
              },
              "same_ip": {
                "type": "boolean"
              },
              "tip_to_send_s": {
                "type": [
                  "number",
                  "null"
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "sync_sessions": {
          "type": "integer"
        },
```

```json
      "type": "boolean"
    },

      "type": "string"
    },

      "type": "string"
    },
```

```json
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "pool": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "action_index": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "recipient": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "value_zat": {
      "type": "integer"
    },

    "msg": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "msg_signed": {
      "const": false
    },
    "explorer": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "title": "ghost --json proof verify",
  "if": {
    "properties": {
      "valid": {
        "const": true
      }
    }
  },
  "then": {
    "required": [
      "txid",
      "height",
      "recipient",
      "value_zat",
      "memo",
      "msg_signed",
      "explorer"
    ]
  },
  "else": {
    "required": [
      "reason"
    ]
  }
}
```
